parsed.rationale: ShowContainerProtocol and TrackContainerProtocol in package Playback are structurally identical across four shared fields (isStale:Bool, lastRefreshedAt:Date?, pageToken:String?) with the sole differing slot being item:Show vs item:Track. This is a textbook PAT opportunity: introducing a single ContainerProtocol<Item> with an associatedtype Item collapses both protocols into one declaration, eliminating the duplication. Both protocols live in the same package (Playback) and neither is a test, mock, codegen, or sample-app artifact, so consolidation is safe. Downstream conformers would simply constrain Item to Show or Track as appropriate.
